summary: The delta 06ee0eec..HEAD contains six commits, each by a single role: Inspector f36fe73e, Architect 5cf54f8e, Engineer 1ac5c50d, Architect 5255ce00, Inspector 43093989, Architect 2b44771d. (1) In packages/auth/test/unit/stynx-auth.guard.spec.ts, the fake JWT is now built with [...].join('.') from the same three segments, so the token is byte-identical and the rejects.not.toBeInstanceOf(InvalidCredentialError) assertion is unchanged. law/trace.json changes one assertion_digest_sha256, with assertion_count still 45, and adds one rebind note. pnpm check:trace, rerun now, reports 393/393. (2) root package.json changes only the adm-zip override from 0.6.0 to 0.6.1. pnpm-lock.yaml changes only that override, the adm-zip integrity/snapshot entries, and github-actionlint's adm-zip dependency. adm-zip is a root devDependency path, not a published package, so no changeset is needed. No .github or workflow file changed. (3) The docs link change is correct after merge; see the nonblocking note. (4) The pin refresh in test/scripts/local-rc-blocker-contract.test.mjs is legitimate. sha256(06ee0eec:package.json) = 44760d4f…, the old pin, and sha256(HEAD package.json) = 5d4fc38a…, the new pin. Exactly three occurrences changed (D21, D22, D16.1), no old pins remain, and every other frozen path, including reference/api and reference/web package.json, is untouched. Precedent 2b1257e5 had the same shape (Inspector, 3 lines, same file), and this change was also judged on its own. The sensor still requires exact byte equality, so it is not weakened. The CI log /private/tmp/stynx-s15-ctg1-ci-pr-repair3.log confirms: trace 393/393, rls-negative OK, api-baseline 44 matched, auth 234/234 (Turbo cache hit keyed on the new spec), tenancy test:int 39/39, test 97/97 with script tests executed on a cache miss (107 pass, 0 fail), test:int 51/51, build 48/48, RLS smoke passed, doctor ok. None of these repairs affects security, tenancy/RLS, public API baselines, or the release lane, so the cycle-5 PASS for 75b9966a..HEAD still holds.
